title: Pure Blitzclique
summary: Every Blitzclique card paired with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck, without a Thunder Dragon or Spright splash. Blitzclique monsters reveal themselves in the hand to destroy cards and Special Summon Thunders from the hand, turning every destruction into searches and follow-up summons.

summary.title: Starters & Hand-Reveal Engine
points: Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb gives the opponent a Token in Defense Position to search any Blitzclique monster from the Deck, providing an immediate destruction target on their field while boosting monsters Special Summoned from the hand.

Surge Blitzclique reveals itself in the hand to destroy a monster on the field and Special Summon a Thunder from the hand; while on the field, it searches a Blitzclique monster whenever another card is destroyed.

Grain Blitzclique reveals itself in the hand to destroy a Spell/Trap on the field and Special Summon a Thunder from the hand; while on the field, it searches a Blitzclique Spell or Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb when another card is destroyed.

Emi Blitzclique triggers when added to the hand except by drawing to destroy a card and Special Summon a Thunder from the hand, then searches a Blitzclique Trap on the field when another card is destroyed.

summary.title: Opening: Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb + Surge Blitzclique
steps: Activate Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb to Special Summon a Token to the opponent's field and search Emi Blitzclique (or Grain Blitzclique).
Emi Blitzclique triggers immediately when added to the hand, destroying the opponent's Token and Special Summoning Surge Blitzclique or Grain Blitzclique from the hand.

Reveal another Blitzclique in hand to destroy a second card and Special Summon Emi; Surge, Grain, and Emi on the field then trigger off the destruction to search Whisker Blitzclique, Blitzclique - Breakaway, and Blitzclique Return Stroke.

summary.title: Hand-Only Lock & Recursion
summary.text: Using the hand-reveal effects of the Blitzclique monsters locks you out of Special Summoning Effect Monsters for the rest of the turn, except from the hand. Because of this restriction, the generic Extra Deck is only used before starting the Blitzclique chain or on follow-up turns, while Blitzclique - Breakaway, Blitzclique - Steppleader, and Blitzclique Overvolt recur themselves and your Thunders back to the hand whenever a card is destroyed by a Blitzclique effect.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Whisker Blitzclique triggers after a card is destroyed by a Blitzclique effect to Special Summon up to 3 Thunders from the hand and destroy up to that many cards on the field, and bounces another Thunder you control to negate a monster effect.
Crackle Blitzclique reveals itself in the hand on the opponent's turn to destroy an opposing monster that activates its effect on the field and Special Summon a Thunder from the hand.

Blitzclique Return Stroke protects your Blitzclique monsters and bounces one to the hand to negate and destroy an opposing Spell, while Blitzclique Overvolt destroys a face-up card and recycles itself from the GY after a Blitzclique destruction.

main: Surge Blitzclique
Reveal it to destroy a monster and summon a Thunder from the hand; on the field, searches a Blitzclique monster whenever another card is destroyed.
Grain Blitzclique
Reveal it to destroy a Spell/Trap and summon a Thunder from the hand; on the field, searches a Blitzclique Spell or the Field Spell.
Emi Blitzclique
Added to the hand other than by drawing: destroys a card and summons a Thunder; on the field, searches a Blitzclique Trap.
Crackle Blitzclique
On the opponent's turn, reveal it to destroy a monster that activates on the field; on the field, sends a Blitzclique Spell/Trap from the Deck to the GY.
Whisker Blitzclique
After a Blitzclique destruction, summons up to three Thunders from the hand and destroys as many cards; bounces a Thunder to negate a monster effect.
Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb
Field Spell: gives the opponent a token to search a Blitzclique monster, and pumps monsters summoned from the hand.
Blitzclique - Breakaway
Places a Blitzclique Continuous Trap from the Deck, or bounces a Thunder to destroy a card; returns to the hand after a Blitzclique destruction.
Blitzclique - Steppleader
Gets a Thunder back from the GY after each Blitzclique destruction, or summons one from the hand.
Blitzclique Overvolt
Newest support. Destroys a face-up card, and returns to the hand after each Blitzclique destruction.
Blitzclique Alternator
Shrinks the opponent's monsters per Thunder; shuffles a Blitzclique card back to search a different Thunder.
Blitzclique Return Stroke
Protects Blitzclique monsters, and bounces one to negate and destroy a Spell.
